name: model-router
description: Quota-aware model routing for Claude Code: keeps the main session on a strong model and pushes mechanical work to cheaper tiers. Ships a standing routing policy (injected at session start), Haiku/Sonnet worker agents (ci-watcher, sweeper, mechanic, reviewer, sysadmin), Sonnet-pinned status-report and ship skills, a one-time per-machine setup that defaults bare subagents to Sonnet, and a bi-weekly per-workstation usage review (flagged at session start when due or when the last analysis is invalid) that measures where the tokens went.
